added.member: UI: feImage href="#id" draws whatever the element draws
added.summary: An feImage of an element now builds the element as <use> builds it, so gradients, patterns, text, images, groups and nested <use> all draw into the filter's input, not only literal shapes with solid paint.

fixed.member: UI: backdrop-filter inside a world panel, a ground or a 3D plane
fixed.summary: A backdrop drawn inside a world panel's, a <ground>'s or a 3D plane's layer now reads what that layer has drawn so far, planned on the layer's own pixels, instead of drawing nothing.

fixed.member: UI: wide blurs and turned morphology are exact
fixed.summary: A blur wider than about 42 device px now reads every texel (split into passes that compose to the exact Gaussian) instead of stepping between texels; a morphology under a rotation takes every texel its segment crosses instead of the nearest one each device px.

breaking.change: FilterUse no longer has images; an feImage's element is built as children of the filtered element whose ElementDraw::element_image numbers it.
breaking.fix: Drop images from FilterUse literals; set element_image: None on ElementDraw literals that list every field.
